mapper.insert:
insert into order_detail (order_id, name, image, dish_id, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, number, amount) values
(#{od.orderId}, #{od.name}, #{od.image}, #{od.dishId}, #{od.setmealId}, #{od.dishFlavor}, #{od.number}, #{od.amount})
mapper.select: select od.name, sum(od.number) number from order_detail od, orders o where od.order_id = o.id and o.status = 5 and o.order_time > #{beginTime} and o.order_time < #{endTime} group by od.name order by number desc limit 0,10
